maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The keypoints in the uppermost row are distributed with increasing inter-point spacing towards the posterior, maintaining a vertical clearance from the primary dense row approximately equal to 1.5 times the average keypoint diameter.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Estimated 20-25% melanin saturation; pigment is concentrated on the superior and lateral margins of the rhinarium, with four distinct, discrete dark spots located on the central and right pink mucosal surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetric pigmentation pattern on the rhinarium, specifically a cluster of three small melanin spots arranged in a triangular configuration on the upper right quadrant of the nose leather.
